framing: fwd = cov(toks(gold), toks(stale)): the share of the successor's tokens the stale string carries (would the stale string read as 'correct' under the PRESENT rule). Because the stale flag is computed on old-only tokens with a cross-guard on new-only tokens, a high fwd does not itself make a gold answer fire (step 1: 0 of 89); the false-positive mechanism the sheets show is a small old-only set whose members are question tokens (E_q). Both are re-scored beside the registered column.
